subject: Urgent: Northlight production slowdown after model v6.2 rollout
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@northlightretail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: David Cho <dcho@northlightretail.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike after model v6.2 rollout

Neha —

We just observed a severe degradation in checkout latency and an uptick in 5xx errors immediately after your team rolled v6.2 with the new quantization profile (int8-fast) around 08:45 PDT. Key symptoms: 

- p95 latency jumped from ~240ms to ~950ms across our hot paths
- 5xx error rate increased from ~0.2% to ~3.6%
- Overall throughput dropped ~28% despite the same traffic pattern

Attached are the traces and a short capture from our side (northlight_hotpath_traces_0401.zip). This is customer-impacting (failed checkouts) — we are seeing revenue drops on the storefront. We need a rollback or immediate mitigation.

Please escalate — we need an engineering bridge and your execs aware if this will be a longer outage.

Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of ML Ops, Northlight Retail
agomez@northlightretail.com
+1 415-555-0133

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@northlightretail.com>, David Cho <dcho@northlightretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike after model v6.2 rollout

Alicia —

Thank you for the signal and traces. I’ve escalated to Rishi and our on-call infra team; Marissa is looped in for account comms. We will open an emergency bridge now and propose an immediate mitigation plan:

1) Rollback to v6.1 (non-quantized) on Northlight's dedicated pool as a hotfix (target T+30–45 min)
2) Run canary traffic on the previous model to validate latency/throughput improvement
3) If rollback is not possible quickly, enable routing policy to divert traffic to the dedicated fallback cluster we pre-provisioned for emergency rollbacks

Please stand by on the bridge; we’ll share an ops channel and keep you updated every 15 minutes. We'll also prepare a credit/compensation discussion if this persists.

Attaching our incident intake and the initial trace folder link to speed triage.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@northlightretail.com>, David Cho <dcho@northlightretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike after model v6.2 rollout

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 9:12 AM Alicia Gomez <agomez@northlightretail.com> wrote:
> We just observed a severe degradation in checkout latency and an uptick in 5xx errors immediately after your team rolled v6.2 with the new quantization profile (int8-fast) around 08:45 PDT.

Thanks for the context and traces — I pasted a couple quick observations from the initial traces:

- The int8-fast profile introduces a different kernel path that increases per-token scheduling jitter under small-sequence hot traffic.
- KV cache invalidations are visible in the trace immediately after the rollout; that is likely forcing repeated warm-up and increasing tail latency.
- We also see a small but meaningful increase in memory fragmentation that could amplify GC-like stalls on our allocator on the dedicated pool.

Immediate plan (go/no-go window = 30 minutes):
A) Rollback v6.2 -> v6.1 on the Northlight dedicated pool (non-quantized default). I estimate 30–45 minutes to cut traffic over and validate canary. Priority: HIGH.
B) If rollback cannot be completed in window, apply a routing policy to send 25–50% of traffic to fallback cluster running v6.1 while we validate — this should reduce pressure on hotpath and reduce 5xx.
C) Post-mitigation: run a targeted perf profile comparing int8-fast vs int8-safe and disable the int8-fast kernel for hotpath endpoints until we can deploy micro-optimizations.

I’m starting the rollback playbook now and attaching the annotated hotpath trace and our rollback-playbook.pdf. I’ll post updates to the ops channel and escalate to infra SREs for kernel-level knobs.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Serving Runtime Engineering, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Production latency spike after model v6.2 rollout — customer comms and exec bridge

Alicia / Neha —

I’m on the bridge and coordinating comms to minimize noise for your ops teams. We will:

- Confirm the rollback timeline and share a concise customer-facing status note every 15 minutes
- Prepare a goodwill package (service credit + postmortem) once we stabilize
- If rollback is completed, we’ll schedule a joint deep dive with Northlight to review test coverage and safe quantization profiles before any re-rollout

Neha — please loop in our Sales Engineering if we need an on-site follow-up. I’m copying Irene for exec visibility; if this crosses revenue-impact thresholds she’ll coordinate the CX/leadership message.

— Marissa

Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@northlightretail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike after model v6.2 rollout

Team —

Confirming rollback to v6.1 completed at ~14:55 PDT and we’re seeing p95 back down to ~260ms, 5xx rate has fallen to baseline. Thank you for the rapid turnaround.

A few follow-ups we need from Redwood: 
- Postmortem with timeline and root cause (kernel path + quant profile decision)
- A plan to validate quant profiles in a more exhaustive way before any customer rollouts (we can share representative traffic shapes)
- Requesting a short executive summary for our CFO — this incident hit peak checkout windows and we will quantify revenue impact; the exec note will help our internal stakeholders.

We are open to a scheduled review next week. Please keep the drive folder updated with your annotated traces and postmortem draft.

Thanks, and appreciate the timely support.

Alicia
